dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps we should politely decline after explaining our reasons.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll talk to the owners.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Bernhard leaves to talk to the people involved...

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight. Paimon. The owners were very reasonable and understood our reply.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: However, the shopkeepers did donate a sum of money to show their support for the charity sale.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, it is fortunate that nothing went to waste this time!
